changelog:
v1.0.1 — Republish with cleaner manifest and standalone repo.

Changes since previous version:
- SKILL.md frontmatter cleaned to use only supported attributes
  (name, description, license, metadata)
- Explicit license: MIT-0 at the top level
- 17 MCP tools across identity, permissions, credentials, audit, and trust
- README updated with both global and workspace-specific install steps
- Now backed by a standalone GitHub repo: github.com/Kzino/vorim-openclaw-skill

The skill provides cryptographic agent identity (Ed25519), scoped permissions, hash-linked audit trails, and a publicly verifiable trust score (0-100) for any OpenClaw agent. Free tier includes 3 agents and 10K events per month, no credit card.
